newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees economy strengthening in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees economy strengthening in 1997.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday recent economic indicators pointed to a strengthening of the Australian economy throughout the 1997 calendar year.

Costello, answering a question from his own side in parliament, listed "opportunities that business can take, that employees will welcome and which will contribute to a strengthening of growth throughout the course of 1997."

The opportunities he listed were: the national savings programme, the government's fiscal consolidation of about A$7.0 billion in the 1997/98 financial year, low inflation, low interest rates, and improvements in investment and company profits.
